settings.title: For active kids
settings.text: We know how active our kids’ lives are as they grow up through the early years - full of growing, playing and learning. Sprout Junior Protein’s all-in-one nutritious shake is a quick and easy way to ensure your kids are getting their daily dose of protein to stay happy, healthy and energised all day, every day.

settings.title: For picky eaters
settings.text: The struggle is real. As parents ourselves, we are all too familiar with kids’ fussy eating habits as they poke that piece of broccoli on a plate for 20 minutes and we insist “just one more bite!!”. We created the Junior Plant Protein Shake to give our kids a delicious source of protein and nutrients that they will love - no questions asked!

settings.title: For peace of mind
settings.text: Are they eating enough? Are they receiving all of the nutrients they need to grow and thrive? These thoughts are front and centre for every parent like us who has opened up a forgotten lunchbox or lost a battle over a healthy meal. Packed with 10g of plant-based protein, and 11 key vitamins and minerals, we created Spout Junior Plant Protein to give you peace of mind in a tasty daily shake that your little ones will look forward to.

settings.title: Not just protein! Jam-packed nutrients
settings.text:
Unlike many kids drinks that are high in sugar and nutritionally empty, Sprout Junior Plant Protein Shake is not just low in sugar and a great source of protein, it is also packed with fruits and vegetables and added probiotics for a jam-packed dose of nutrients in their day!

Each serving of Sprout Junior Plant Protein contains:

10g of complete plant protein
50% daily needs of iron
40% daily needs of vitamin D
40% daily needs of vitamin B12

… and so much more!

settings.title: Healthy
settings.text: Plant-based nutrition easily provides infants and children with all the energy and nutrients they need to grow and thrive. Current research shows that children who are raised on healthful plant-based diets also have a reduced risk of heart disease, cancer, obesity and diabetes.

settings.title: Sustainable
settings.text: Our choices matter. Right now, we’re consuming resources at a far greater rate than can be restored. Plant-based nutrition offers a dramatically lower carbon, water, and ecological footprint, making it the best choice to ensure a sustainable future for our kids.

settings.title: Inclusive
settings.text: At Sprout, inclusivity is a founding pillar of who we are. Food brings us together, and we believe that one of the best ways to foster inclusivity is to create nutrient-rich foods for kids which are free from ingredients that cause 90% of all allergic reactions (eggs, fish, milk, peanuts, shellfish, soy and wheat). Our products are also certified vegan and Kosher friendly, making them a convenient choice for all kids to enjoy!
